description: Standalone Module 3 execution: a minimal, reusable offline pathway (case-associated evidence -> m3_corporate_management specialist + deterministic structural processing -> Validator 7 -> governed M3 JSON outputs) via a new run_m3 service and a run-m3 CLI subcommand matching repo conventions, an inspectable standalone demo dir (m3_corporate_structure.json, m3_analysis.json, m3_structure_provenance.json, validation_report.json, evaluation_scorecard.json, run_manifest.json with the EXACT reproduce command), and a senior-management claim benchmark built from REAL admitted HCA 10-K excerpts (provisional labels). Invokes ONLY M3's specialist + applicable validation; NO other BO specialist, NO cross-module/downstream agent, NO general-purpose orchestration framework. Depends on FEAT-001 (consumes the de-wrapped export, sidecar and hardened validator/conclusion).
steps: Create app/services/bo/m3_standalone.py with run_m3(session, *, case_id, evidence, metrics, corporate_structure_document=None, m3_responses, transaction_borrower_entity_id=None). Mirror app/services/bo/single_specialist.py::run_m1s2 but use V3_SPEC_BY_CODE['M3']: comparison.prepare_specialist(...) then comparison.run_single_pass(session, prep, m3_responses['single_pass']); persist AgenticAnalysisRun (analysis_mode e.g. 'agentic_bo_m3_standalone'), EvidencePacketRow, and an AuditLog event. When corporate_structure_document is provided, build the source via completion.admit_corporate_structure_source(document, case_id=case_id, source_document_id=...) and attach it to the specialist call inputs under 'corporate_structure_source' so completion.build_m3_corporate_structure can read it; otherwise fail closed to the unavailable artifact.

In run_m3, after the specialist run: validate the proposal with m3_validation.validate_m3_assessment (reuse the runner's allowed-evidence-id + evidence_texts + validated_borrower_entity_ids wiring exactly as app/services/bo/runner.py does around line 944); build the structure artifact with corporate_structure.build_corporate_structure_artifact(source, expected_case_id=case_id); assemble sections with m3_output.assemble_m3_output; build deliverables with m3_artifacts.build_m3_deliverables (de-wrapped). Return an M3StandaloneResult dataclass carrying analysis_run_id, packet_hash, the governed assessment, the two deliverables, the structure sidecar, validation issues, and a run_manifest dict.

run_m3 MUST invoke ONLY m3_corporate_management: do NOT call BusinessOverviewRunner.run_specialists/run_case, Agent 6, the orchestrator, challenger, synthesis, scoring, memo, handoff or any downstream agent. Build the run_manifest with: case_id, source document ids + hashes (document_hash from admit_corporate_structure_source; evidence snapshot version), specialist id/validator_id ('validator_7')/prompt version/roster version (ROSTER_V3_VERSION)/transform version (CORP_STRUCTURE_TRANSFORM_VERSION), model/execution settings (model_called flag, execution_mode, scripted model id), output validation status, and the structure+analysis artifact ids.

Create app/services/bo/m3_demo.py with write_m3_demo(result, output_dir) writing six files with app.core.hashing.canonical_json (byte-stable, newline-terminated): m3_corporate_structure.json (de-wrapped Deliverable A; skipped when unavailable, mirroring fail-closed), m3_analysis.json (Deliverable B), m3_structure_provenance.json (sidecar; skipped when unavailable), validation_report.json (Validator 7 validation_issues + rejected_items + per-finding dispositions + completion status), evaluation_scorecard.json, and run_manifest.json (result.run_manifest + an exact 'reproduce_command' string naming the run-m3 CLI invocation).

In m3_demo.py, compute evaluation_scorecard.json with EXPLICIT denominators and named test populations: corporate-structure accuracy (entity/relationship/guarantor counts vs the simplified input and vs the reference, round-trip consistency, determinism hash) and management analytical quality (via m3_semantic_eval.evaluate over the management benchmark cases, carrying its numerator/denominator and actual_llm_semantic_accuracy='not_measured'). Include an explicit 'completeness_caveat' string stating a passing scripted set is NOT proof of real-world correctness and the eval is not perfect/complete.

Add a run-m3 subcommand to app/cli.py mirroring run-bo-specialists: positional case_id; mutually-exclusive --package / --bundle (+ --cutoff for bundle); --corporate-structure (Path to the simplified v1.0 onboarding JSON, optional); mutually-exclusive --responses (scripted offline JSON) / --live (guarded, not exercised in tests); --transaction-borrower-entity-id; reuse the top-level --output. Add _run_m3(session, database, args): build the package/evidence via CreditMemoPipeline.prepare_case (as _run_bo_specialists does), load the corporate-structure document when given, call run_m3 with a ScriptedBoBackend.from_file(args.responses) (offline) or the guarded _live_backend(), then m3_demo.write_m3_demo into args.output, and print a JSON summary (case_id, analysis_run_id, corporate_structure_status, completion status, output file paths, model_called).

Create the management benchmark fixtures under examples/bo_m3/management_benchmark/: cases.json with ~5-10 MATERIAL management claims whose 'passage' values are VERBATIM excerpts located in the tracked HCA 10-K (examples/healthcare/hca-2025/filing/0001193125-26-044769/hca-20251231.htm, hca-ex21.htm, hca-ex22.htm) with exact source location/anchor + reporting period; each case carries BOTH a credibility label (expected entailment/verification) AND a SEPARATE credit_direction label, plus label_status 'developer_authored_awaiting_external_review' and all LLM-generated interpretation marked PROVISIONAL. Include at least one case where management credibly explains an ADVERSE development (credible statement, still credit-negative) and one CORRECT-value-with-UNSUPPORTED-causal-attribution case. Add manifest.json with source path + sha256 for each cited filing file, and README.md stating the labels await external review and mocked/provisional output is not proof of real performance. Do NOT invent claims; drop any passage that cannot be located verbatim. If no verbatim offline excerpt is feasible for a case, mark that case SCRIPTED/MOCK explicitly.

Confirm the offline admitted-evidence path: verify the benchmark passages exist verbatim in the tracked htm files before committing (grep the files). Record in the FEAT findings whether the management benchmark uses REAL admitted 10-K excerpts (preferred) or, per case, SCRIPTED/MOCK, so FEAT-003 and the demo can state it accurately.
acceptance_criteria: run_m3 runs offline with a ScriptedBoBackend and the simplified HCA onboarding document and returns both deliverables (A de-wrapped root shape, B referencing A by artifact id) plus the sidecar and a run_manifest; with no onboarding document it fails closed (A unavailable with exact NO_JSON_MESSAGE, B still assessed, status partial); with a wrong case association it fails closed.
run_m3 persists exactly one AgenticAnalysisRun/EvidencePacketRow for m3_corporate_management and runs NO other BO specialist or downstream agent (verifiable from persisted rows / audit).
DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -m app.cli run-m3 --help exits 0 and shows case_id, --package/--bundle, --corporate-structure, --responses/--live, --transaction-borrower-entity-id.

write_m3_demo produces m3_corporate_structure.json (de-wrapped root), m3_analysis.json, m3_structure_provenance.json, validation_report.json, evaluation_scorecard.json (explicit denominators + completeness_caveat + actual_llm_semantic_accuracy 'not_measured'), run_manifest.json (with an exact reproduce_command); byte-stable across repeated runs.

examples/bo_m3/management_benchmark/cases.json contains 5-10 material claims with verbatim HCA 10-K passages (or per-case SCRIPTED/MOCK where no verbatim excerpt exists), each with SEPARATE credibility and credit_direction labels, including a credible-adverse case and an unsupported-causal-attribution case; manifest.json source sha256 hashes resolve against the tracked files.
verification: Import checks: DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -c "import app.services.bo.m3_standalone, app.services.bo.m3_demo; import app.cli"

Benchmark provenance: a small check (added in FEAT-003 or a scratch run, then removed) that each manifest.json sha256 equals hashlib.sha256 of the referenced file and each non-SCRIPTED passage substring is found in its cited htm file.

Functional end-to-end coverage is provided by FEAT-003's tests/integration/test_bo_m3_standalone.py; this feature leaves the code buildable and the CLI runnable offline. Run DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_bo_m3_onboarding_transform.py tests/unit/test_bo_m3_corporate_structure.py tests/integration/test_bo_m3_v6_integration.py -q to confirm no regression from the new wiring.
findings:
STANDALONE SERVICE (app/services/bo/m3_standalone.py). Signature: run_m3(session, *, case_id, evidence, metrics, m3_responses, corporate_structure_document=None, corporate_structure_source_document_id='corp-onboarding-1', transaction_borrower_entity_id=None, sector='auto') -> M3StandaloneResult. Mirrors single_specialist.run_m1s2 using V3_SPEC_BY_CODE['M3']: comparison.prepare_specialist(... run_identity='bo-m3-standalone-1.0') then comparison.run_single_pass(session, prep, m3_responses['single_pass']); persists ONE AgenticAnalysisRun (analysis_mode='agentic_bo_m3_standalone') + ONE EvidencePacketRow(agent_id='m3_corporate_management') + an AuditLog event 'bo_m3_standalone_executed'; persist_arm writes hypothesis rows + validator audit. Validator 7 runs via m3_validation.validate_m3_assessment over arm.parsed['m3_assessment'] with allowed=set(prep.packet.evidence_ids), evidence_texts=prep.passage_text (filtered to allowed), validated_borrower_entity_ids={transaction_borrower_entity_id} or set(). Deterministic structure via completion.admit_corporate_structure_source(doc, case_id, source_document_id) -> attached under call inputs 'corporate_structure_source' -> completion.build_m3_corporate_structure (reuses the trusted case-association + v1.0->v2.0 transform; wrong/absent case fails closed). Sections via m3_output.assemble_m3_output; deliverables via m3_artifacts.build_m3_deliverables (de-wrapped A + sidecar + B). Invokes ONLY m3_corporate_management: NO other BO specialist, NO Agent 6/orchestrator/challenger/synthesis/scoring/memo/handoff/downstream agent, NO general-purpose orchestration (verified: exactly 1 AgenticAnalysisRun, 1 packet with agent_id=='m3_corporate_management'). model_called detection: a call is offline when model_config.simulation is truthy OR backend=='fake' (the internal FakeLLMBackend used by run_single_pass tags backend='fake' with no 'simulation' key).

M3StandaloneResult fields: case_id, analysis_run_id, packet_hash, governed_assessment (model_dump|None; carries added replay_provenance {kind:'offline_deterministic_standalone_validation', model_called, source_analysis_run_id, transaction_borrower_entity_ids}), m3_corporate_structure (Deliverable A de-wrapped root; None when unavailable), m3_analysis (Deliverable B), m3_structure_sidecar (governed record; None when unavailable), m3_output (full three-section output), corporate_structure_status, completion_status, validation_issues, rejected_items, specialist_validated, specialist_failure, model_called, run_manifest. run_manifest keys: document/version/case_id/analysis_run_id/scope('M3_only')/invoked_specialist_agent_id/invoked_specialist_code/validator_id('validator_7')/cross_module_or_downstream_invoked(False)/evidence{snapshot_version,packet_hash,packet_evidence_ids}/source_documents{corporate_structure:{source_document_id,document_hash,registered_case_id}|None}/versions{roster_version=ROSTER_V3_VERSION, transform_version=CORP_STRUCTURE_TRANSFORM_VERSION, agent_registry_version/hash, scoring_config_version, prompt_agent_id}/execution{execution_mode='offline_simulation', model_called, model_id, specialist_validated, specialist_failure}/validation{...completion_status, requires_human_review True, forced_outcome False}/artifacts{corporate_structure_status, structure_artifact_id, analysis_schema_version}.

DEMO WRITER (app/services/bo/m3_demo.py). write_m3_demo(result, output_dir, *, simplified_document=None, reference_output=None, corporate_structure_path=None, responses_path=None) -> dict[str,Path]. Writes up to SIX byte-stable files (app.core.hashing.canonical_json, newline-terminated): m3_corporate_structure.json (de-wrapped A; SKIPPED when unavailable, fail-closed), m3_structure_provenance.json (sidecar; skipped when unavailable), m3_analysis.json (B, always), validation_report.json (Validator 7 validation_issues + rejected_items + per-finding dispositions incl. credit_direction/credibility_vs_direction_note + completion status), evaluation_scorecard.json, run_manifest.json (result.run_manifest + 'reproduce_command'). evaluation_scorecard.json has top-level actual_llm_semantic_accuracy='not_measured', completeness_caveat string, corporate_structure_accuracy{refined_counts, count_checks (vs_simplified_input.* and vs_reference_output.* entities/relationships/guarantors), count_accuracy{numerator,denominator}, roundtrip_consistent, determinism_hash (content_hash of de-wrapped A, None when unavailable)}, and management_analytical_quality = m3_semantic_eval.evaluate over an in-memory adaptation of the management benchmark (carries its explicit numerator/denominator metrics, dataset_id, actual_llm_semantic_accuracy='not_measured', plus benchmark_grounding, credit_direction_distribution, credible_adverse_cases, unsupported_causal_attribution_cases). The benchmark adaptation maps credibility.expected -> 'expected' and is written to a temp file that is removed after evaluate() (no temp left in the demo dir).

CLI (app/cli.py). New 'run-m3' subcommand: positional case_id; mutually-exclusive --package/--bundle (+ --cutoff for bundle) + --entity-id/--entity-name; --corporate-structure (Path to simplified v1.0 onboarding JSON, optional); mutually-exclusive --responses (scripted offline JSON)/--live (guarded: _run_m3 raises ValueError 'offline standalone; --live not supported'); --transaction-borrower-entity-id; reuses top-level --output. _run_m3 builds evidence via CreditMemoPipeline.prepare_case (like _run_bo_specialists), loads the corporate-structure doc when given, calls run_m3 with m3_responses=json.load(--responses), then m3_demo.write_m3_demo into args.output (passing the Sample HCA Corp Structure Final Output.json as reference_output only when a --corporate-structure is supplied), and prints a JSON summary (case_id, analysis_run_id, scope, specialist, validator_id, execution_mode, model_called, specialist_validated, corporate_structure_status, completion_status, issue/rejected counts, output paths). 'DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -m app.cli run-m3 --help' exits 0 and shows case_id, --package/--bundle, --corporate-structure, --responses/--live, --transaction-borrower-entity-id.

EXACT REPRODUCE COMMAND format (run_manifest.json.reproduce_command): 'DEBUG=false python -m app.cli --output <OUTPUT_DIR> run-m3 <CASE_ID> --corporate-structure <PATH> --responses <PATH>' (the --corporate-structure / --responses args are appended only when supplied).

BENCHMARK (examples/bo_m3/management_benchmark/): cases.json (8 MATERIAL cases, dataset_id 'bo-m3-management-benchmark-1'), manifest.json (3 source files + sha256), README.md. GROUNDING STATUS: ALL 8 cases are REAL-admitted verbatim HCA FY2025 10-K excerpts (NO SCRIPTED/MOCK cases). Verified: each passage substring is present in the normalised text (tags stripped, entities unescaped, whitespace collapsed) of its cited htm, and each manifest sha256 equals hashlib.sha256 of the file. Sources + sha256: hca-20251231.htm=2043cd0346a1ca36748348b6bef4bdf02385ee772eb241794fcffc98c8c6ba8c; hca-ex21.htm=740b8fbe9ae56934cdd74ef6d86712a895a81ae330fa9d3f9ff992c481d93d77; hca-ex22.htm=59f8b83d0084fad9f71257bf0b6e2fe614cdfcaa58de797e23c07637f22f68fc. Each case carries a SEPARATE credibility{expected,evidence_basis,reason} label AND a credit_direction{label,reason} label, label_status 'developer_authored_awaiting_external_review', all interpretation PROVISIONAL. Required special cases present: CREDIBLE-ADVERSE = M3-03 (credible staffing/labour risk, credit-negative; credible_adverse=true), UNSUPPORTED-CAUSAL/OUTCOME-ATTRIBUTION = M3-05 (real succession-planning disclosure, claim adds an unstated outcome -> credibility 'insufficient'; unsupported_causal_attribution=true). Credit-direction distribution: 6 neutral, 2 negative.

VERIFICATION: import checks for app.services.bo.m3_standalone, app.services.bo.m3_demo, app.cli PASS; 'run-m3 --help' exits 0 showing all required flags; targeted suite (test_bo_m3_onboarding_transform.py + test_bo_m3_corporate_structure.py + test_bo_m3_v6_integration.py) = 55 passed (no regression); full offline suite = 1384 passed / 131 skipped / 12 known pre-existing errors (untracked output/ dir), zero new failures. A scratch integration test (run during development, then removed) confirmed: full-structure run -> completion 'complete', de-wrapped A root, exactly 1 AgenticAnalysisRun + 1 m3_corporate_management packet, byte-stable demo files, scorecard with explicit denominators (numerator==denominator for HCA counts) + not_measured + completeness_caveat + exact reproduce_command; missing-doc run -> fail closed (A unavailable with NO_JSON_MESSAGE, B assessed, status 'partial', m3_corporate_structure.json NOT written). NOTE for FEAT-003: m3_demo.py must not contain borrower tokens 'HCA'/'Galen'/'Stryker' (guarded by tests/unit/test_bo_remediation.py::test_case_coverage_checks_are_data_and_state_no_conclusion).
